mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction, which precedes equity market weakness and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), manufacturing sector momentum supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (y/y).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates accelerating labor market weakness, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200.0 thousand units signal strengthening consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0 thousand units during post-recession phases.
